description: Returns a 1-hour link where the user uploads their own photos and files into a folder of a site (get_site lists them). replace_site: true, only when the user asks to replace the whole site: a one-use link for a zip that becomes every file. Publishes nothing until the user uploads.

folder.description: Target folder (default images); not with replace_site

replace_site.description: true: a one-use link for a zip that replaces the whole site

name: create_upload_link
title: Get an upload link
